messages:
Sam W: Quick PSA — release cutoff in ~8h. Also reminder on changelog voice: customer-facing, one-liners, avoid internal acronyms.
Mira P: Thanks. Can you paste a short 'approved tone' example we can copy?
Sam W: Sure, copy/paste the shape below:
```good
- Component: API | Category: fix | One-liner: Fix rate-limit handling for streaming responses (user-facing)
```
```bad
- backend: fixed throttling bug that caused null ref in handleRequest, added guard, see #1234 (too internal)
```
Kai L: Where do we put component tags now? still `Component:` or use `area/`?
Sam W: Stick to `Component:` for changelog. Use pipe-separated fields. Example: `- Component: eng-runtime | Category: perf | One-liner: Improve KV cache hit rate`.
Chris D: If folks paste long bullets will the lint bot trim or just flag?
deploy-bot: changelog-lint: 3 entries flagged — reason: message >140 chars. Run `/changelog-lint --fix` or see https://go/release/changelog-guidelines
Tess H: I'll clean the flagged ones. @Sam W can we relax 140 -> 200 chars for infra-only items?
Sam W: Keep 140 for user-facing items. For infra-only add `(internal)` prefix and it's allowed up to 240 chars.
Mira P: Also, version bump: should RC be `0.9.7-rc.1` or `0.9.7-next`?
Kai L: Freeze main merges at cutoff. Create a release branch `release/0.9.7` for cherry-picks.
Chris D: I'll open a tiny PR to fix a formatting nit.
Sam W: :thumbsup: Last call in 2h. If flagged, ping me or DM and I'll help merge quick fixes.
